name: Isla del Dragón
hero_subtitle: Islote rocoso con forma de dragón dormido — acceso en barco, kayak o marea baja.

overview.title: Silhouette in the middle of the bay
overview.p1: Dragon Island (Île du Dragon) rises from the lagoon with a ridge that, from the right angle, looks like a dragon at rest. It is one of Dakhla’s signature boat stops.
overview.p2: At low tide some approaches allow walking or wading; otherwise small boats and kayaks do the job. Expect shells, open views and bird life depending on season.
overview.p3: There is no village on the island. Bring water, sun protection and respect the quiet of a protected lagoon landscape.

q1.question: Why is it called Dragon Island?
q1.answer: Its outline from certain angles resembles a sleeping dragon.

q2.question: Can I walk there?
q2.answer: Sometimes at low tide; otherwise go by boat or kayak.

q3.question: Is there a fee?
q3.answer: Usually included in a boat outing rather than a separate island ticket.

q4.question: Are there facilities?
q4.answer: No — treat it as a short natural stop.

q5.question: Good for families?
q5.answer: Yes on calm boat trips with sun protection and water.
